quarterly_data.quarter: SUMCO press release: Presentation - Result for Q2 FY2026 (08-06-2026)
quarterly_data.signal: Market environment (results deck): in Q2 2026, 300mm wafer shipments increased with strong demand for leading-edge logic and memory for AI, and 200mm shipments also increased, helped by AI data center-related demand. Pricing: long-term contract prices were honored; negotiations have begun on spot price revision. Q3 view: strong AI-driven 300mm demand should continue centering on leading-edge logic and memory, non-leading-edge logic is on track for recovery as customer inventory drawdown proceeds, 200mm should recover gradually; long-term contract prices are being maintained and moves toward spot price revision are under way.

quarterly_data.quarter: SUMCO press release: Presentation - Result for Q2 FY2026 (08-06-2026)
quarterly_data.signal: President Jiro Ryuta (results deck): as AI advances from generative to agentic AI, CPU data-processing volume and memory needs are expected to increase greatly, so AI-driven semiconductor demand is expanding from GPU and HBM to CPU, DRAM and NAND. SUMCO says the server demand outlook is being revised upward (SUMCO estimates based on research companies' data) and demand for leading-edge logic and memory wafers for servers is expected to increase greatly; SUMCO will upgrade existing manufacturing equipment to better meet leading-edge wafer demand.
